{{NintendoService |name=Twitch |logo=[[File:Twitch.png|200px]] |caption=Twitch Logo |provider={{wp|Amazon (company)|Amazon}} |launched=June 6, 2011[https://thenextweb.com/news/twitchtv-justin-tvs-killer-new-esports-project ''TwitchTV: Justin.tv’s killer new esports project'' - TNW] (retrieved June 14, 2025) |shutdown=N/A |serviceprovided=Live-streaming platform |accessableby=Web, mobile, smart TVs, consoles, etc. |externallink=[https://twitch.tv/ twitch.tv] }} '''Twitch''' is an online live-streaming platform, owned by {{wp|Amazon (company)|Amazon}}. The service allows users to create and see live streams, comment on them, and subscribe to other users' "channels". It is used by [[Play! Pokémon]] since the [[2013 World Championships]] to officially broadcast some of its minor tournaments, Regional Championships and Special Championships as well all International and [[World Championships]] events. Covered games are presented in the specific channels for each game. Days from International and World Championships events that only feature the Final match are however showcased exclusively in the [https://www.twitch.tv/pokemon Pokemon] channel. Starting within the [[Pokémon Day#2016|Pokémon Day 2016]], Twitch is also often used to show already aired [[Pokémon animated series]] episodes, commonly through the [https://www.twitch.tv/pokemon Pokemon] channel. ==Official Pokémon Twitch channels== === Active channels === {| class="roundtable" style="margin:auto; background: #9147FF; border: 3px solid #9147FF" ! style="background-color:#A970FF" | Icon ! style="background-color:#A970FF" | Channel name ! style="background-color:#A970FF" | Content ! style="background-color:#A970FF" | Other languages |- | [[File:Pokemon Twitch icon.png|60px]] | [https://www.twitch.tv/pokemon Pokemon] | Core series VGC

style="background-color:#A970FF" | Icon ! style="background-color:#A970FF" | Channel name ! style="background-color:#A970FF" | Content |- | [[File:Twitch Watches Pokémon Twitch icon.png|60px]] | [https://www.twitch.tv/twitchwatchespokemon Twitch Watches Pokémon] | [[Pokémon the Series]] |- | [[File:PokemonVGC Twitch icon.png|60px]] | [http://twitch.tv/pokemonvgc PokemonVGC] | Core series VGC{{tt|*|Up to the 2020 Latin America International Championships}} |- | [[File:Pokemon_Asia Twitch icon.png|60px]] | [https://www.twitch.tv/pokemon_asia Pokemon_Asia] | [[Pokémon UNITE]] |- | [[File:PokkenTournament Twitch icon.png|60px]] | [https://www.twitch.tv/pokkentournament PokkenTournament] | [[Pokkén Tournament]] |} ==Twitch Extension== [[File:Twitch 2025 NAIC.png|thumb|Overview of the [https://www.twitch.tv/pokemontcg PokemonTCG] channel during the 2025 North America International Championships stream, with the live chat omitted and an expanded overlay feature.]] {{incomplete|section|Info about the Twitch Extension interactive overlay (captions, schedule, etc.)}} Unlike on [[YouTube]], Twitch live streams for events can feature an overlay for minor features, including collecting "Watch Badges" from events that are merely cosmetic and being able to hover on [[Trading Card Game]] cards in the stream's HUD to see their full view. ==Twitch Drops== {{main|Twitch Drops}} Beginning in the 2023 North America International, International and Worlds Championships streams award viewers which have watched them through a certain period of time rewards known as Drops, in the form of items for the stream's related games. Since the [[2024 World Championships]], other Drops are also available in co-streams of the same events from partnered channels. Some of the rewards are only obtainable through these methods. To earn them, the viewer requires to link their Twitch and [[Pokémon Trainer Club]] accounts in the [https://rewards.pokemon.com/ Pokémon Twitch Rewards Program] page, claim the rewards while watching the streams live and logged in said Twitch account, and then generate a code to claim the items in their respective games at the Rewards Program page. Rewards will expire if not claimed past a certain date. ==Twitch Global Badges== Twitch Badges (not to be mistaken with Watch Badges) are small icons displayed next to a viewers username as they talk in streamers chats. Twitch Global Badges are rewarded to viewers who subscribe or gift subscriptions to streamers, while they stream in a specific category.
